notes: One-hour PC-first animation dependency cycle: actor/controller/evaluator to local node PRS, cached-world consumers and skin palette. No PS2 analysis, executable rescan, in-game integration, release or push. Fixed catalog and direct-SMO/SAN denominator retained; scores are reviewed logic coverage, not byte coverage.

classes.summary: PC nine-slot vtable, complete input roles, sampled PRS blending, native key-cache/time/weight behavior and actor insertion caller are established and reconstructed as a bounded portable slice. Full input ownership/capacity, key decoder, protected constructor and outer frame integration remain open.

evidence.observation: Corrected earlier seven-slot scout to nine slots, ending at 0x00711428 class string. Each 0x30 input holds playback, track, unsigned priority and three 3-index caches. Sampling uses playback+0x34 time and +0x0C weight, not the outer time argument.
Native insertion orders priority and mutates playback+0x48; clear zeroes only pointers. No local capacity guard is established; the third-input case is deliberately not executed.

evidence.locator: evaluator PRS/cache and actual quaternion chain
evidence.observation: Whitelisted PC evaluator instructions reproduce empty/single/two-input validity, persistent caches, time source, weighted vectors, null-track hole and weighted quaternion through real slerp. Sampling is an explicit synthetic seam, not full SAN decoding.
Portable finite-input PRS blending and blank clone are built/tested; sampling and caller-driven insertion remain seams with explicit two-input safety guard.

classes.summary: PC exact 0x18 ownership layout, complete 12-slot vtable, default track evaluator, blank clone, direct and transition local PRS application reconstructed. Const evaluator, protected rotation tail, world propagation and original names remain open.

evidence.observation: Native factory allocates 0x18; +0x10 is intrusive-owned node and +0x14 directly deleted transform evaluator. Constructor kind 0 creates track evaluator, kind 1 const evaluator. Clone uses no-payload copy.

Controller calls evaluator +0x20. Valid local position/scale writes set node flags bit 1. Transition interpolates changed position/quaternion with epsilon 0.001 but copies scale directly. Rotation setter enters protected tail after matrix conversion.
Native apply/blend bodies pass controlled fixtures, including the joined native quaternion conversion/interpolation path; protected rotation setter remains an explicit recording seam.
Built local PRS/ownership/blank-clone slice, with inferred file placement, shared_ptr substitute for intrusive ownership and documented host null guards.

classes.summary: PC identity, exact 0x54 allocation, observed playback 0x60 layout, node discovery/binding and tick-to-controller dispatch established. Full state machine, callbacks, outer frame caller, teardown and protected copy are not reconstructed.

evidence.observation: Actor factory allocates 0x54, vtable has nine slots. Playback storage has 0x60 stride and controllers vector lies at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48; unnamed fields remain opaque.

Actor tick updates playback then dispatches controller +0x20(sampleTime, elapsed/duration) when duration positive, otherwise +0x1C(sampleTime). This is static call-path proof; full actor tick was not executed.

Tree binding selects named animated nodes not already marked 0x2000, attaches node controller and performs exact-name slot binding; visible protected-binder tail connects actor state and animation tracks into evaluator.

classes.summary: Concrete PC actor/controller callers establish the extra abstract +0x1C slot as time-driven application. Minimal portable dependency interface added, without claiming original method name or full controller ABI.

evidence.observation: The previously unnamed abstract slot has a float time argument and local-transform consumer. Protected spController copy and physical-vs-engine hierarchy remain distinct.

classes.summary: Existing SAN storage/serializer evidence is joined to actor playback and evaluator consumers. Key-descriptor memory prefix and real linear-position sampling established; all encodings/tags/time padding, protected defaults and full serializer remain open.

evidence.observation: PRS track pointers at +0x18/+0x24/+0x30 refer to descriptors with count, representation, times and values. In/out caches and linear packed Vector3 sampling verified on synthetic native tracks.

Native two-key interval helper returns index 0/fraction 0 at and after last time; the endpoint reaches the real track sampler output. Three-key endpoint reaches the final key. No in-game bug claim: upstream time/padding invariants remain unknown.

classes.summary: Local controller writes establish dirty bit 1; native consumers establish cached-world PRS and orthonormal transform convention. World-update virtual +0x30 and its visible parent/child/dirty tail are located; protected preamble, frame caller and complete collision/billboard contract remain open.

evidence.observation: PC cached world fields are position +0x74, scale +0x80 and orientation +0x8C. Independent point consumers and skin accesses agree; ABI opaque block replaced with asserted fields.

Native forward scales then row-rotates then translates; inverse uses transpose/divide for orthonormal nonzero scale. Node controller position/scale writes set flags bit 1; protected quaternion setter tail is not guessed.

Node virtual +0x30 enters a protected preamble then visible tail: inherited dirty bit 1 gates recomputation, masks 0x10000/0x20000/0x40000 gate parent PRS, collision entries refresh, children receive combined flags with bit 2 cleared, final flags clear bits 1/2/4. This is tail-only static evidence, not proof of protected entry or whole updater execution. Native Matrix3 multiplication independently confirms local times parent orientation order.

classes.summary: Exact row-indexed inverseBind times boneWorld product and native cleanup branch established, with portable matrix helper and native replay. Protected builder entry, cached-world update and complete stream/failure lifecycle remain open.

evidence.observation: Skin passes inverse-bind as this and bone-world as argument; native 4x4 product and copy reproduce C[r,c]=sum inverseBind[r,k]*boneWorld[k,c], verified by noncommuting and 64 matrix cases.
Corrected former unconditional-cleanup description: renderer bone count +0xC9BC is reset only along successful completion, not all error exits.
Added tested inverse-bind times bone-world helper without inventing node world-cache update or protected builder prologue.
